Feature.Description: Read and write a single PLC device word over the KEYENCE KV COM+ Library (DBCommManager.ReadDevice / WriteDevice). The server is stateless: each command opens a KV COM+ connection, performs the one-word operation, then disconnects. Device type codes and device numbers are passed through to the library unchanged; this feature is signal-agnostic and assigns no meaning to particular addresses. Multi-word (e.g. 32-bit) values are reconstructed by the client from consecutive single-word reads/writes.

Command.Description: Read one device word via DBCommManager.ReadDevice(DeviceType, DeviceNumber). Returns the raw word value as an integer.

Parameter.Description: The KV COM+ device type code (e.g. 18 = DM for KV-8000).
The device number, passed to the library as a string (e.g. "6010").

Response.Description: The word value returned by ReadDevice.

Command.Description: Write one device word via DBCommManager.WriteDevice(DeviceType, DeviceNumber, Value).

Parameter.Description: The KV COM+ device type code (e.g. 18 = DM for KV-8000).
The device number, passed to the library as a string (e.g. "5010").

DefinedExecutionError.Description: Failed to create the KV COM+ object or to connect to / communicate with the PLC.
The device read or write operation failed (e.g. invalid device type or number).
